title: Reduce exact ordered-row reuse to exact multinomial count coupling
statement: Supply A~Mult(m,P) and require whole B~Mult(m,Q) with E||A-B||1/(2m)<=TV(P,Q)+eta, using only the same paid source samples/bits. Given actual ordered X and B generated from A alone, keep a uniform min(A_i,B_i)-subset of actual positions labelled i, then uniformly fill residual positions from the residual B multiset. Every changed position necessarily changes label, giving EXACT changes=||A-B||1/2. Conditional on A,B the old ordering is uniform and the lift is permutation-equivariant, so Y is uniform on type B; mixing exact Mult(m,Q) gives ENTIRE Q^m, including zero probabilities. Conversely simulate a uniform type-A Xstar internally, apply any ordered policy and count its output. Count distance is at most its mismatches; the actual-position lift afterwards preserves the stored-row contract. Thus the minimax infima are EXACTLY equal, including adaptive stopping/nonattainment, not merely equivalent in order. Exact integer rejection/Fisher-Yates needs O(m) draws, each expected<=2 trials, O((m+d)polylog(m+d+2)) bit work and paid list/counter storage; no extra oracle queries are hidden. Neither conditional Y|A=Q^m nor a new attaining query bound is asserted.
